text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky-san, I hear it's your birthday 
today. Happy birthday!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wait, my birthday? ...Oh, right! That's 
right, that's right~~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You don't say... Don't tell me you forgot 
your own birthday?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: No, no, that's not true at all~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Still, yeah. I never imagined I'd be 
celebrated like this, so...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
To hide your embarrassment... yeah, thank 
you. I won't forget your kindness, King... 
*sniff*

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
G-Geez, I have no choice then! I, King, 
will make your birthday a truly 
unforgettable day!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'll celebrate it next year, 
too! You'd better remember that well.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Did I go a bit too far?
